items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I don’t know if Benny told me this himself, I can’t remember, or if the secretary, Muriel Zuckerman told me, I’m not sure, but it came from him anyways

ctx.x: Well I just said he didn’t seem to make any friends on that particular tour.

Oh I know what it is. So he had told me over the phone. I didn’t have anything written, no nothing written. He told me over the phone he’d pay me $500 a week. And back in those days, back in ’62, that was a good sum of money. So I certainly said yes obviously. I go to get my first paycheck and it’s $400. And the reason it’s $400 is — I don’t know if Benny told me this himself, I can’t remember, or if the secretary, Muriel Zuckerman told me, I’m not sure, but it came from him anyways — he said 500 because he…
